name: CargoHub – Kargo Takip Sistemi
author: RomiTeT

sections.description:
CargoHub, WooCommerce mağazaları için tasarlanmıştır. Gönderi bilgilerini yönetmeyi kolaylaştırır ve müşterileri kargo durumu hakkında bilgilendirir.

Key Features
– Custom cargo carriers (add and manage via admin)
– Email notifications to customers when tracking is added
– WooCommerce order integration and My Account display
– Responsive design and accessibility-friendly styles
– Security-conscious implementation (sanitization, escaping, nonces)

This plugin does not require any external services. All processing happens locally in WordPress.

Optionally, a separate PRO offering (distributed outside WordPress.org) provides additional features such as SMS integrations. The free plugin hosted here remains fully functional by itself.

Developer Information

Developed by RomiTeT Creative

  • Website: https://www.romitetcreative.us
  • Support: WordPress.org support forums
  • Documentation: Included in the plugin admin panel

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.3 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data. All tracking information is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Support

For support, please use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/cargohub-kargo-takip or install via the Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
  4. Open the CargoHub menu in WordPress admin
  5. Add your cargo carriers
  6. Add tracking info to orders
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

How many cargo carriers can I add?

You can add cargo carriers from the admin without any built-in limits.

Does it send SMS?

This free plugin sends email notifications. SMS features are available in a separate PRO offering outside WordPress.org.

Is it compatible with Turkish cargo companies?

Yes. It’s tailored for Turkish e-commerce and supports defining local carriers.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. It includes responsive styles for common breakpoints.
